v0.1.1 修复了 Windows 下 Codex 任务通知丢失及通知命令超时的问题，使提交任务后自动开始 Steam 游玩状态、任务结束后自动退出的联动恢复正常。

- 修复 PowerShell 调用通知接收程序时未传入任务信息的问题。
- 修复后台进程占用通知命令输入输出管道，导致通知无法及时返回的问题。
- 保持静默运行、无日志、无开机自启；Steam 未安装或未运行时仍直接退出。

下载 `CodexSteamBridge-v0.1.1-windows-x64.zip`，解压后双击 `CodexSteamBridge.exe`。v0.1.0 用户请选择原安装目录并点击“安装 / 修复”，完成后在 VS Code 执行“开发人员：重新加载窗口”，再提交新任务；账号、库条目和图片会保留，未变更通知沿用已有授权。

源码包为 `CodexSteamBridge-v0.1.1-source.zip`，文件校验值见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。本机 35 项功能测试、6 项进程测试通过；用户已确认真实 Codex 新任务可以自动联动 Steam。Windows 11 普通用户桌面验证及 Steam 关闭竞态仍待独立实测，支持边界见包内 `COMPATIBILITY.md`。

---

v0.1.1 fixes lost Codex task input in the Windows PowerShell notification command and inherited pipe handles that prevented the one-shot receiver from returning while its worker remained active. Silent operation, no logs, no login startup and immediate exit for missing/stopped Steam are preserved.

Download `CodexSteamBridge-v0.1.1-windows-x64.zip`, extract it and run `CodexSteamBridge.exe`. For v0.1.0 upgrades, select the existing installation and choose Install / repair; run Developer: Reload Window in VS Code before submitting a new task. Existing accounts, shortcuts, artwork and trust for unchanged handlers are preserved.

Source and SHA-256 checksums are attached. All 35 local functional tests and six process checks passed, and the user confirmed automatic integration with a real new Codex task. Independent Windows 11 standard-user desktop and live Steam-exit race checks remain outstanding; see `COMPATIBILITY.md`.
